people.name: Chilion
people.line: Son of Elimelech and Naomi; husband of Orpah

people.name: Mahlon
people.line: Husband of Ruth, son of Elimelech and Naomi.

translations.web: Mahlon and Chilion both died, and the woman was bereaved of her two children and of her husband.
translations.bsb: both Mahlon and Chilion also died, and Naomi was left without her two sons and without her husband.
translations.kjv: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.
